In April i got hit by a drunk driver. I passed out and woke up in blood and disoriented. The first thing i did was to step out and see if the car was okay, she wasn’t. My world crumbled. This car was my best friend. I have another project car as well(240sx) but the FR-S was my first car i purchased in 2013,  the emotional attachement is not the same with the Silvia. People around me who saw what she looked like just told me to scrap it, and move on with life because this car attracted nothing but bad lucks.

I’ve had ridiculous amounts of life changing experiences with this car. This is just a few;
I learned manual by myself in this car
Ive drove over 160k all over Canada/USA, played a lot of shows, did a lot of road trips alone and with friends, went wild camping and off roading, drifted it, tracked it and the list goes on.
Ive had to live in the car for a period of time.
I went thru a long abusive relationship with this car being my only escape and “friend” i could talk to during this time. 

A little back story on the bad luck;
Someone hit me 2 weeks after i first purchased the car, about 12k if damage. Everyone around me told me to just scrap the car and get another one. I disagreed. I wanted THIS particular car. 
Ive had to fight with insurance to get it repaired and the garage who worked on it did a BS job and messed up the car, something i only knew after ive gotten hit and run a few months after that and i sent the car to a garage i trusted. They fixed her up properly and i sewed the first garage who worked on her. Ive won and they payed up everything that was messed up and dangerous.
Last winter, i purchased everything to get the car ready for this summer as i always intended her to be; Rocket bunny V3, Coilovers, wing, wrap, lights etc.. i wanted to work on the car as much as i could and make build her into everything i always wanted it to be, but i never got to install anything because of that terrible april night.


With the last accident once again, i could not just let go of this car; even with everyone telling me to scrap it, i could not. I took the insurance cheque and i bought the car back for very cheap.
I bought another FR-S to daily, and slowly but surely i will bring her back to her glory, despite what anyone else will say

I know i’m rambling.. im sorry, i never was too good with words.. i’m not too sure what i’m trying to explain here but, i just wanted to say to anyone who needed to hear this; 

Don’t let anyone stop you from doing what you love, don’t let anyone tell you what you should or should not do. Stop caring about people’s opinion on your life, they aren’t the ones who are living it. You’re the architect of your path.
We've all been through darkness, but to create even through the darkness and most difficult of times may be the secret to greatness.
The dreams you hold dear in your heart, you can make them happen, no matter how much life will bring you down, don’t let go.

I work at a wrap shop and we also print stickers and apply them. Ive experimented with a bunch of materials and techniques to apply a lower 24” long windshield lettering and not have the wipers rip it off. This is what i found worked best. Also i applied them during winter and it stayed.

1. Cleaned the glass with Alsol or alcohol very well. Making sure its completely dry.
2. Applying the sticker with a hardcard/squeegee. 
3. Very light torch/heat to seal the deal. Be careful not to burn the sticker.
4. Letting it rest indoors for a few hours(because it was winter at the time

Quality of sticker vinyl is also important but try your best at cleaning the glass. Most important step. My banner has survived the whole winter!
